caveats: Small paired pilot, not a statistical superiority claim.
Hidden checks never enter model prompts or selection decisions. Stopping uses only public gates.
Development uses one manually planted training bug. Its lesson is validated against real child RTL and the complete gate suite.
Transfer is measured on an unseen failure family, not an unknown contract rule.
Token and wall costs exclude shared development; tokens are provider-reported and incomplete calls are not estimated.

limitations: Only one training failure and one lesson.
Claude alone and raw retrieval passed 6/6 designs on held-out and first-try transfer. Graph passed 6/7 designs and 5/6 first-try transfer; no graph advantage was observed.
One graph initial design left its occupancy output undriven; a repair passed all gates.
The original lesson contained an incorrect pre-edge count narrative. Its frozen corpus and all results are retained unchanged. A later revised lesson pipeline is a separate experiment.
Small paired study. No statistical superiority claim.
